title: Learned genomic models predict Baltic microbial niche placement
summary: Models trained on functional-gene profiles predicted microbial distribution along salinity, depth and sampling-fraction gradients in Baltic Sea observations. The study links genomic repertoire to ecological niche placement within this ecosystem. It does not demonstrate that associated genes causally determine habitat or that the models transfer elsewhere. The genome clusters are not separately counted discoveries.
organization: KTH Royal Institute of Technology; Leibniz Institute for Baltic Sea Research

evidence.tested: Predictions were compared with observed distributions in the sampled ecosystem.
evidence.unknown: Causal effects, field manipulation and cross-ecosystem transfer were not established.
evidence.ai_role: Genome-feature regression and tree-based learning supported the stated study; experimental and interpretive work remained with researchers.

source_review.scope: Indexed primary publisher abstract, date and affiliations, plus institutional publisher-PDF metadata; Methods review retained from frozen research.
